description: This file defines a helper class 'Log' that serves as an interface to Android's native Log utility. It provides methods for logging at various levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT), manages a chain of LogNodes for logging output, and includes constants for log levels.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class for managing and forwarding log messages, mimicking or extending Android's native Log class, with support for chaining LogNodes.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode that will receive log messages.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Dispatches a log message to the chain of LogNodes.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level.
